remarks: Nestled in a tranquil cul-de-sac neighborhood, this contemporary-style home offers an exceptional living experience. Boasting 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this residence features vaulted and exposed beamed ceilings, 3 fireplaces, and beautiful hardwood flooring throughout. The abundance of windows floods the home with natural light, enhancing its airy ambiance. The open floor plan provides a spacious layout, including a finished basement with a versatile bonus room perfect for a home office and a finshed bathroom. The master suite is a true retreat, complete with vaulted ceilings, fireplace, a private porch, and an en-suite bathroom with large walk in closet. Set on just over an acre, the property provides a private oasis with a large deck accessible from both the kitchen and living areas, as well as an expansive yard ideal for family gatherings and outdoor activities. With your personal touch, you can transform this home to reflect your unique style. Conveniently located, this property offers easy access to Long Ridge Road and the New York state line, making it an ideal location for commuters. Don't miss the opportunity to make this serene retreat your own!
